species.denotes: Effective IFN-γ-driven transcriptional activity shared by all four genes; lumps receptor/JAK/STAT1 activation, nuclear STAT1 and any co-activators. Not a STAT1 concentration and not observed.
species.unit_convention: Dimensionless; 0 without IFN-γ, unattenuated stimulated steady state exactly 1 (scale fixed by the shared k_A)
species.lump_membership: All IFN-γ-dependent transcriptional input upstream of the four promoters

species.denotes: Upstream signalling stage between the IFN-γ input and the activity: a first-order delay of the stimulus (receptor engagement and JAK activation lumped). Not observed.
species.unit_convention: Dimensionless; relaxes to IFNg (1 under IFN-γ, 0 in controls) with rate k_Sin

species.denotes: Fraction of the initial effective IFN-γ stimulus still acting; lost in proportion to the activity (receptor down-regulation or ligand consumption lumped). Not observed.
species.lump_membership: Ligand depletion and loss of receptor responsiveness

species.denotes: Generic unmeasured attenuator produced in response to A (phosphatases, PIAS, receptor down-regulation lumped), inhibiting the generation of A. Not observed.
species.unit_convention: Dimensionless, in inhibition units: the generation of A is divided by (1 + R); basal 0
species.lump_membership: All A-induced negative regulators other than an explicit SOCS1-transcript route

species.denotes: Delayed copy of the activity that drives CXCL9 and CXCL10 production (a stand-in for secondary induction through co-activators). Not observed.
species.unit_convention: Units of A (steady state A2 = A)
species.lump_membership: Secondary transcriptional input to the chemokine promoters

species.denotes: IRF1 transcript, measured by probe ILMN_1708375 (data column IRF1_log2)
species.unit_convention: Relative to its own basal steady-state level (basal = 1). The readout is log2 intensity: log2(IRF1_mRNA) plus an offset (the baseline log2 intensity, per donor if declared); no second log of the data
species.lump_membership: All IRF1 mRNA isoforms hybridising the single probe

species.denotes: SOCS1 transcript, probe ILMN_1774733 (data column SOCS1_log2); the measured mRNA only, never the protein
species.unit_convention: Relative to basal steady state (basal = 1); log2 readout with offset as for IRF1. Control values near 6.1-6.6 log2 are the array floor

species.denotes: CXCL9 transcript, probe ILMN_1745356 (data column CXCL9_log2)
species.unit_convention: Relative to basal steady state (basal = 1); log2 readout with offset. Basal and most control values sit at the array floor (6.1-6.6 log2), so basal = 1 maps to the floor, not to a measured abundance

species.denotes: CXCL10 transcript, probe ILMN_1791759 (data column CXCL10_log2)
species.unit_convention: Relative to basal steady state (basal = 1); log2 readout with offset; many control values are at the array floor

species.denotes: Precursor of the culture-handling transient: a stimulus-independent signal present in every culture at t = 0 (both arms), converted to H2. Not observed; not IFN-γ biology.
species.lump_membership: Whatever handling or medium change at t = 0 induces CXCL10 in untreated cells

species.denotes: Active form of the culture-handling transient, driving extra CXCL10 production and decaying at k_H. Not observed; never acts on A.

parameters.role: IFN-γ stimulus level, set per condition
parameters.convention: 1 in every stimulus = IFNg condition (200 IU/ml), 0 in every stimulus = control condition including the 0 h arrays

parameters.role: Rate of the upstream signalling stage (delay of the stimulus reaching A)
Generation and deactivation rate of the activity A (one shared rate fixes A's scale)
Activity-dependent loss rate of the stimulus fraction
Gain of the attenuator: R is produced at G_R*A
parameters.convention: 1/h; with k_R it sets the attenuation strength (G_R/k_R at steady state) and timescale (1/k_R)

parameters.role: Relaxation rate of the attenuator R
Rate of the delayed activity stage A2 driving the chemokines
IRF1 mRNA degradation rate; also its basal production rate in basal units
SOCS1 mRNA degradation rate; also its basal production rate in basal units
CXCL9 mRNA degradation rate; also its basal production rate in basal units
CXCL10 mRNA degradation rate; also its basal production rate in basal units
Fold of basal IRF1 production at saturating activity
Inverse half-saturation of IRF1 promoter activation by A
Activity-dependent SOCS1 production per unit A, relative to basal
A2-dependent CXCL9 production per unit A2, relative to basal
A2-dependent CXCL10 production per unit A2, relative to basal
CXCL10 production per unit of the handling transient H2, relative to basal
Rate of the handling transient (H1 -> H2 -> loss)
